en-US.promotionalText: A quieter way to know yourself. Explore your strengths, keep a daily reflection on your Home Screen, and share a thoughtful reminder from your Life Manual.
en-US.description:
Pluto Life Manual is a private self-reflection companion for iPhone and iPad. Enter your birth date, time, and place to create a personal reading on your device. Explore your energy type, decision-making style, strengths, relationships, and everyday rhythm.

START WITH YOUR STRENGTHS
Read a clear text summary and three practical highlights, then explore a detailed Life Manual with examples for work, relationships, and daily life. The app focuses on readable results and reflection.

A THOUGHT FOR TODAY
Find one small suggestion on your home page, based on your latest saved Life Manual. Daily tips are reflection prompts, not predictions or forecasts. Add a small or medium Pluto widget to your iPhone or iPad Home Screen.

SHARE A LITTLE ENCOURAGEMENT
Create a daily-tip image, save it to Photos, or use the system share sheet. A QR code opens Pluto's website. The shared card contains the tip and date, without your name or birth details.

YOUR SPACE, ON YOUR DEVICE
Reopen saved readings offline, manage local history, and clear records whenever you choose. No account, ads, tracking, subscription, or in-app purchases. Place search requires a connection and sends the place-search text to a third-party geocoding service; see our Privacy Policy for details.

DESIGNED FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
A calm dark interface, flexible tablet layout, portrait and landscape support on iPad, and matching English and Simplified Chinese readings.

The corresponding source code and third-party licenses are available at https://github.com/Yonge6/human-design-chart.

For personal reflection and entertainment only. Pluto does not provide scientific conclusions or medical, psychological, legal, or financial advice.

zh-Hans.promotionalText: 从了解自己开始，让每一天更自在。阅读你的优势与决策方式，把今日提示放上桌面，也可以生成带二维码的分享卡片，将一句生活建议送给朋友。
zh-Hans.description:
Pluto 人生使用说明书，是为 iPhone 与 iPad 设计的个人自我探索工具。输入出生日期、时间和地点，在设备上生成专属文字解读，了解你的能量类型、决策方式、优势、关系与日常节奏。

先看见自己的优势
清晰的结果摘要与三个重点，帮助你开始阅读。详细解读结合工作、关系和日常生活场景，提供可以尝试的小练习。App 以易读的文字结果为核心。

每天，一句生活提示
根据最近一次保存的说明书，在首页展示一句生活建议。今日提示是自我观察与反思的练习，不是运势、预言或事件预测。支持 iPhone 与 iPad 桌面的小号、中号 Widget。

分享一份温柔的提醒
把今日提示生成图片，保存到照片或通过系统分享面板分享。卡片右下角的二维码可打开 Pluto 网站。分享图片仅包含提示与日期，不包含姓名或出生资料。

你的空间，留在自己手中
保存过的说明书可离线重看，历史记录保存在本机，并可随时删除。无需注册，没有广告、追踪、订阅或 App 内购买。地点搜索需要联网，并会将搜索文字发送给第三方地理编码服务；详情请查看隐私政策。

适合 iPhone，也适合 iPad
安静的深色界面，适应平板的布局，支持 iPad 横屏与竖屏，提供完整的简体中文和英文界面与解读。

源代码及第三方许可：https://github.com/Yonge6/human-design-chart

本应用仅用于个人自我探索与娱乐，不构成科学结论、医疗、心理、法律或财务建议。

reviewNotes:
No account or login is required.

Build 6 replaces the withdrawn Build 4. This update includes an iPad layout, Home Screen widgets, a redesigned daily reflection home page, and daily-tip image sharing. The native app now presents text results and practical readings. No BodyGraph drawing, diagram template, or chart artwork is bundled or displayed in the native app.

Pluto is a bilingual self-reflection tool. Daily tips are deterministic suggestions selected from reflection text using the latest saved reading and calendar date. They are not daily predictions, transits, forecasts, or event predictions.

Suggested review flow:
1. Launch the app and enter a fictional name, such as Alex.
2. Select a date and time (for example 1 January 1990, 12:00), then search for Shanghai, China.
3. Generate the Life Manual. Review the text summary, three strengths highlights, and Detailed Reading.
4. Return to the home page to see today's tip from the latest saved reading. Tap Share image to preview a card, save it to Photos, or open the native system share sheet. The QR code links to https://human-design.wonderelian.com/. The card excludes name and birth data.
5. On the iPhone or iPad Home Screen, add the Pluto Daily Tip widget in small or medium size. It uses the latest locally saved reading. Tap it to open the daily-tip home page.
6. Open the menu to revisit local History or inspect Privacy settings. Saved readings can be reopened offline; new place search needs an internet connection.
7. On iPad, inspect portrait and landscape layouts. English and Simplified Chinese can be selected in the app header.

Calculations run locally using bundled Swiss Ephemeris data. There is no login, account, advertising, tracking, analytics, subscription, or in-app purchase. Birth details and history remain on-device. The App Group shared with the widget contains only language and dated tip text, not name or birth details. Place search sends search text to geocoding providers to resolve coordinates.

For personal reflection and entertainment only; no scientific conclusions or medical, psychological, legal, or financial advice. The screenshots were captured from the updated native app using fictional example data.
